name: MessageCard
label: Message card
description: A structured rich-content card embedded in a chat message, with media, title, body, and actions.

props.name: title
props.description:
Card heading.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which MessageCard does not expose.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two lines under the title.

props.name: media
props.description: Top media slot — an image or chart, inset from the card edges with its own rounded corners.

props.name: icon
props.description: Small leading icon beside the title — a Material Symbol name, or any custom element.

props.name: meta
props.description: Free-text metadata line, e.g. a domain or date, so callers keep their own formatting.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Action row rendered in a footer outside the body — small secondary or
tertiary Buttons, mirroring ToolCall's actions footer.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content between the description and the footer — rich content, a Prose block, an AttachmentGroup.
